description.value: Cap'n Hook is a distinctly west-coast hybrid: a fishing supply shop and coffee bar rolled into one, located in Ucluelet on Vancouver Island's rugged outer coast. The café pours Creekmore's certified organic coffee, locally roasted on the Island, with the option to linger over a harbour view or grab a cup to go. The quirky pairing of fishing tackle, frozen bait, and specialty espresso makes it a memorable and characterful stop for cyclists passing through 'Ukee.'
